scientific_integrity: The proof uses exact Fourier-basis weighted shifts, inverse Laurent series, a rank-one cross block and independently bounded diagonal blocks. Numerical finite sections are supplementary only.
scientific_limitations: Only coordinate symbols on radially weighted complex harmonic Bergman spaces with alpha>-1; asymptotic interior bound, exact exterior bound; motivating preprint and older 2002 full text were inaccessible, so priority not independently settled.
title: Sharp interior resolvent blow-up for coordinate Toeplitz operators on weighted harmonic Bergman spaces
